items.question: How long does installation take?
items.answer: Most residential installations are completed in a single day. Commercial projects depend on complexity, but we plan everything to minimise disruption.

items.question: Does treated water lose important minerals?
items.answer: Our systems can include selective remineralisation, ensuring healthy, balanced water without compromising purity.

items.question: What is the maintenance cost?
items.answer: We offer transparent maintenance plans with predictable costs. Preventive maintenance extends equipment life and guarantees consistent quality.

items.question: Do you treat borehole and well water?
items.answer: Yes. We specialise in all water sources — mains, borehole, well and rainwater harvesting. Each source requires a different approach.

meta.title: About Us — Water Pro | Purity and health in every drop
meta.description: Discover the story, mission, vision and values of Water Pro — a reference in water purification solutions for homes and businesses across Portugal.

about.title: Who We Are
about.lead: Water Pro was born with a simple and powerful purpose: to transform the water that flows into Portuguese homes and businesses into a genuine source of health, wellbeing and trust.

who.title: Specialists in pure water
who.p1: Water Pro specialises in purification, wellbeing and sustainability solutions. We serve both residential and commercial clients, always focused on personalisation, trust and real results.
who.p2: We believe every client is unique. That's why we don't sell off-the-shelf equipment — we study your water source (mains, well or rainwater), assess hardness and quality, and only then recommend the right solution for your context.
who.p3: With nationwide coverage, we support every project from first contact through installation and maintenance, ensuring every drop from your tap reflects the commitment we make to you.

mission.label: Mission
mission.title: Health in every drop
mission.description: To deliver health and wellbeing through pure water and accessible technology — so families and businesses can enjoy the best water quality without complications.

vision.label: Vision
vision.title: A reference in Portugal
vision.description: To be the reference in Portugal for personalised water purification solutions, recognised for technical excellence, client proximity and proven results.

promise.label: Commitment
promise.title: Real results
promise.description: We carry out a technical visit before any proposal. Our focus isn't selling — it's solving. Every solution is tailor-made, with full transparency and ongoing support.

values.title: What guides us every day
values.subtitle: Trust, transparency, innovation, sustainability and service excellence aren't just words on our website — they're criteria that guide every decision we make.

items.title: Trust
items.description: We build lasting relationships based on honesty, close support and delivering on our promises.

items.title: Transparency
items.description: We explain every step of the process, with no fine print. Clients know exactly what they're getting and why.

items.title: Innovation
items.description: We select cutting-edge osmosis, softening and purification technologies for top performance and energy efficiency.

items.title: Sustainability
items.description: We promote conscious water use, plastic reduction and solutions that protect both the environment and your budget.

items.title: Service excellence
items.description: From free analysis to installation and after-sales support, every interaction reflects our quality standard and respect for the client.

journey.title: Every client is unique
journey.subtitle: We work with personalised technical support. After first contact, a Water Pro specialist reaches out to understand your situation and guide you to the right path.

steps.title: First contact
steps.description: Reach out by phone, WhatsApp, email or our contact form. Our team responds with care and speed.
